'''Hachioji Shrine''' (八王子神社, Hachioji Jinja) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|izumidachou|ja|泉田町|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q18987927}}, {{ill|Kariya, Aichi|en|Kariya, Aichi|qid=Q389515|lt=Kariya}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture}}. Its historical Rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|ca|Classificació moderna dels santuaris xintoistes|es|Anexo:Santuarios sintoístas según el sistema moderno|fr|Système moderne de classement des sanctuaires shinto|ja|近代社格制度|simple|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|sv|Moderna systemet för rangordning av shinto-helgedomar|zh|近代社格制度|qid=Q712534|lt=Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines}} was that of a village shrine.

== deity ==
* {{ill|Kunisatsuchi no Mikoto|ja|国狭槌尊}}

== History ==
The exact date of the shrine's foundation is unknown.<ref name="Yusho">"Yusho" (Historical Records), Hachioji Shrine.</ref> The shrine building was constructed in August 1173.<ref name="Yusho"/> Subsequent reconstructions occurred in {{ill|Eiroku|en|Eiroku|qid=Q1143341|lt=Eiroku}} 2 (1559) in September and in {{ill|Meireki|en|Meireki|qid=Q1192766|lt=Meireki}}元年 (1655) on November 16.<ref name="Yusho"/>

In the aftermath of the {{ill|Typhoon Vera|en|Typhoon_Vera|qid=Q1060156|lt=Typhoon Vera}} on September 26, 1959, the shrine sustained significant damage, including the loss of ancient cedar trees.<ref name="Yusho"/> In 1872, it was designated as a village shrine under the shrine Ranking system.<ref name="Yusho"/>

== Grounds ==
* Shrine Hall
* Shrine Office
* Preservation Hall
* Purification Pavilion
* Chōzuya (Water Ablution Pavilion)
* Stone Monuments
** Jinchikuseki (Earth-Tamping Stone) and Chikaraishi (Power Stone)
** "Memorial to Fallen Soldiers"
** "Monument to Soldiers of the Russo-Japanese War"
* Hachioji Shrine Shell Mound
* Izumida Kofun (Ancient Kofun)
** Excavated in December 1960 from a field in Izumida-cho Miyahigashi, 200 meters southeast of Hachioji Shrine. While the tumulus was destroyed during agricultural development, artifacts such as two human skeletons, five gold rings, {{ill|Sue pottery|en|Sue pottery|qid=Q7634351|lt=Sue pottery}}, and iron arrowheads were recovered. Dating back to the mid-to-late 6th century, the site featured a {{ill|Yokoana-style stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}} with stones forming its walls. A reconstructed stone chamber now stands on the shrine grounds, with the original artifacts preserved in the {{ill|Kariya City Museum of Local History|ja|刈谷市郷土資料館|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17226430}}.

== Cultural Properties ==
=== Municipal Historic Sites ===
* Hachioji Shrine Shell Mound
** Designated on November 11, 1958.<ref>[https://www.city.kariya.lg.jp/kankobunka/rekishibunka/bunkazai_iseki/bunkazaishitei.html Kariya City Cultural Properties List], Kariya City.</ref> The site represents a {{ill|Yayoi period|en|Yayoi period|qid=Q207858|lt=Yayoi period}} shell mound. Kariya City hosts other significant archaeological sites, including the Yama-no-Kami Site (Paleolithic, located on the grounds of {{ill|Kariya East Junior High School|ja|刈谷市立刈谷東中学校|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q24514395}}), Honkariya Shell Mound ({{ill|Jōmon period|en|Jōmon period|qid=Q52824|lt=Jōmon period}}, located at Honkariya Shrine), and Izumida Kofun (Kofun period).

== Visitor Information ==
=== location ===
* Address: Izumida-cho Nakanishi 96, Kariya City, Aichi Prefecture, Japan.

=== Access ===
* By Rail: Approximately a short walk from {{ill|Fujimatsu Station|en|Fujimatsu Station|qid=Q5507435|lt=Fujimatsu Station}}, served by the {{ill|Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line|en|Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line|qid=Q1137838|lt=Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line}}.
